name: Copies
description: Three copies of a label and of a photo through one queue. The label proves the printer-language path: the Windows spooler must show one job for all three copies, and CUPS carries the count as a job attribute. The photo is the control: on Windows it goes through GDI, where the device mode carries the count.

jobs.description: a Zebra ZPL label, three copies in one job
a JPEG, three copies in one job
